description: Self-documenting UAT test report rendered as the welcome splash when HUMAN_TESTING=true. Provides real-time visibility into test progress, bugs, and enhancements during a test cycle.

requirements.requirement: QA Report header with two summary tables: build range (start/end/count) and scenario summary (total/passed/deferred/failed/to-test)
Feature tracking table with columns: #, Feature, Done (Y/DEF/FAIL/blank), Bugs Fixed, Feat Impl
Done column statuses: Y (passed), DEF (deferred), FAIL (failed), blank (untested). Only Boss can set these during UAT.
Repeating header row every 7 features for readability
Notes section showing all features with notes (bugs, enhancements, deferrals, failures)
Auto-incrementing build number on each server restart
HUMAN_TESTING flag in .env toggles test mode. Production override: if ENV_PREFIX=prod, test mode is always false (commented out, activate when ENV_PREFIX routing is live).
Frontend fetches /welcome from API (not hardcoded). Supports dynamic welcome content.
GFM markdown table rendering with bordered cells (remark-gfm + rehype-sanitize whitelist)
Start build and end build tracked in header. Builds Tested count computed automatically.

governance.uat_signoff_rule: Only Boss can mark features as pass, fail, or deferred. Claude documents bugs and implements fixes but does not change UAT status.
governance.production_override: HUMAN_TESTING is always false in production regardless of env var setting.
